description: This file contains API route definitions for job postings, including CRUD operations, listing, searching, and filtering for a job portal backend. It defines endpoints accessible to employers and general users, with authentication and authorization logic, as well as Pydantic schemas for request and response models.

classes.name: JobBase
classes.description: Pydantic base model for job data, including title, description, location, salary, and activation status.

classes.name: JobCreate
classes.description: Pydantic model for creating a new job, inherits from JobBase.

classes.name: JobUpdate
classes.description: Pydantic model for updating existing job details, all fields optional.

classes.name: JobRead
classes.description: Pydantic model for reading job data, includes ID, posted_at timestamp, and employer ID; configured with ORM mode.

methods.name: get_current_user(db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), token: str = Depends(oauth2_scheme))
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user based on JWT token, raises 401 on failure.

methods.name: create_job( job: JobCreate, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Creates a new job posting linked to the authenticated employer.

methods.name: list_my_jobs( db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Lists all jobs posted by the current employer.

methods.name: get_job( job_id: int, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific job by ID, with access limited to the employer who posted it.

methods.name: update_job( job_id: int, job_update: JobUpdate, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Updates an existing job posting if the user is the employer who created it.

methods.name: delete_job( job_id: int, db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Deletes a specific job posting, ensures only the posting employer can delete.

methods.name: list_jobs( db: Session = Depends(database.get_db), search: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Search in title/description/location"), location: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Location filter"), min_salary: Optional[int] = Query(None, description="Minimum salary (as integer, if possible)"), only_active: bool = Query(True, description="Only active jobs") )
methods.description: Lists, searches, and filters available job postings, supports keyword search, location, and minimum salary filters, defaults to active jobs only.
